card.name: Linking words in drug interaction lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (that, and, commas) right after a drug name or drug class in interaction text, especially after erythromycin or in phrases like 'drugs that'. It predicts another interacting drug or a drug-class descriptor next.

modes.label: After erythromycin in lists
modes.description: An 'and' or comma following erythromycin or a similar CYP3A4 inhibitor in a list of examples.

modes.label: 'that' after drugs
modes.description: The word 'that' introducing a relative clause after 'drugs' in interaction warnings.
modes.example: signs and symptoms of excessive exposure to the drugs<< that>> are substrates of OATP1

modes.label: Drug combination heading
modes.description: 'and' joining two drug names in a combination-therapy heading.
modes.example: Combination Therapy with Clarithromycin<< and>> Amoxicillin

card.plain: It fires on the small joining words in lists of interacting drugs, just before the next drug or drug group is named.
